staker_has_staked_nft.meaning: staker holds liquidity NFTs custodied by the CL gauge before the withdraw attempt

emergency_flag_active.meaning: the CL gauge's emergency flag is true (emergency mode active)

admin_can_flip_emergency.meaning: gauge owner (governance) is able to flip the emergency flag on at any time

nft_recovered.meaning: the staker successfully recovers the staked liquidity NFT via a callable withdrawal route

nft_inaccessible_during_emergency.meaning: users cannot recover their liquidity NFTs while emergency mode is active, leaving funds inaccessible for the entire pause window
nft_inaccessible_during_emergency.checkpoint: during emergency mode after staker calls withdraw

assumptions: Emergency mode is a conditional scenario state; the report does not confirm the flag was active in an observed transaction.
The staker is treated as any permissionless caller; no unauthorized-caller condition is claimed.
Governance retains the ability to flip the emergency flag, but the report does not state whether or when it is cleared.

unresolved.description: Report does not specify the duration of the pause window or whether governance actually clears the emergency flag, so the 'entire pause window' extent of inaccessibility cannot be bounded numerically.

limitations: The claim formalizes only the target impact liquidity_nfts_inaccessible_during_emergency_mode; other impacts are handled in separate passes.
The 'entire pause window' duration is not numerically defined; the effect is modeled as the NFT not being recovered during emergency mode.
Whether the withdraw call reverts is a root-cause mechanism, not encoded as a precondition.
